deploy.yml synced ./web/dist to s3://fas-apps/... but the host Worker
serves from the fgs-games bucket, so this game never appeared live
(uploaded bytes went to the FAS bucket the host doesn't read). Swap to
s3://fgs-games/games/<repo>/ to match host/wrangler.toml. Matches the
canonical template + fixed fgs-cli generator.

fix: sync pnpm-lock with @freegamestore/games ^0.14.0 bump

CI's `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` has failed on every push since the
0.14.0 SDK bump (commit 4e5ee58, 2026-05-26) updated web/package.json but
not the lockfile (ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE: lockfile ^0.13.3 vs manifest
^0.14.0). Result: no build, no deploy for ~2 weeks — the live site still
serves the 2026-05-21 build, so the topbar/selection/zoom fixes never
shipped. Regenerating the lockfile unblocks the pipeline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: disable pinch/double-tap zoom on mobile

Add user-scalable=no to the viewport meta so taps during gameplay don't
accidentally zoom the page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: single topbar + reliable card selection

- Remove the duplicate in-game stats bar; fold Moves/Time into the
  platform GameTopbar stats and move Undo into its actions slot, matching
  the single-topbar convention used by every other game.
- Fix card selection: tapping a new card after selecting one now
  re-targets the selection instead of clearing it (tryMove reports
  success; illegal moves re-select the tapped card). Extracted a pure
  computeMove() and moved side effects out of the setState updater.
- Stronger selection highlight (accent ring + tint + bigger lift).

fix: AI never pre-solves + input buffering + held-key support

- AI NEVER calls solve() during gameplay. It explores blind every time.
  Optimal path only computed on win/loss screen for comparison.
- Input buffering: press next direction before reaching the turn, it
  queues and applies when current direction hits a wall or the buffered
  direction becomes passable (whichever comes first).
- Held keys: tracks keydown/keyup. If you hold up+right simultaneously,
  releasing up switches to right automatically. No lost inputs.
- D-pad uses the same applyDir function as keyboard.

feat: AI always explores blind — smartness controls intelligence

All difficulties now use blind exploration (no pre-solving). The AI
doesn't know the maze layout — it discovers it step by step, just
like the player. Smartness controls how often it picks the best
neighbor vs random:

- Easy (20%): drunk random walk, gets very lost
- Medium (50%): coin-flip between smart and random
- Hard (80%): usually picks the right direction
- Expert (95%): almost always optimal, but still backtracks at dead ends

No more cheating. The AI makes visible mistakes on every difficulty.

- Eye highlight dot for depth
- Pulsing red exit marker with star

- Cleaner scoreboard with color-coded labels
- Consistent timer display on win/loss screens

fix: correct wild4 turn-line flow, add Wild4LightningSVG, fix Safari card animations

Turn-line sequencing:
- uno.ts: set currentPlayer = victim when wild4 is played (same as skip/draw2),
  so the rainbow turn line naturally travels attacker → victim before acceptDraw4 fires
- useUnoGame: wild4 effect now triggers on activeSeat === target (victim) instead of
  attacker; acceptDraw4 and challenge-fail paths revert to single setState
- GameBoard: pendingWild4ForHuman checks activeSeat === 0 (victim arrived); wild4
  added to UNO-call suppression so victim doesn't get a ghost tag while being hit

Wild4LightningSVG:
- New component: rainbow segment travels along the inner loop path from attacker to
  victim using CSS transitions (same architecture as DealLightningSVG / turn line),
  replacing the broken straight-line SVG approach
- DealLightningSVG: upgrade filter to scale=24 + feMerge blur/displaced layers,
  remove chained CSS drop-shadow that killed the SVG filter in Safari

Safari animation fixes:
- Strip filter: drop-shadow() and z-index from all card animation keyframes
  (card-draw-arc, card-play-arc, card-play-direct, card-play-bounce, init-card-arc,
  card-keep-arc, card-draw-direct) — mixing filter + transform in the same keyframe
  prevents Safari from GPU-compositing the transform, silently dropping the jump/arc

fix: size the canvas when it mounts (game rendered broken)

The resize effect had an empty dependency array, so it ran once on mount
during the 'avatar' phase — when the canvas doesn't exist yet — and never
again. The canvas kept its default 300x150 backing buffer (CSS-stretched)
while game logic used a stale 400x600, so the ground was off-screen and
the bird was mispositioned. Re-run resize on phase change so the canvas is
sized once it actually mounts into 'playing'.

Also fix the Best score: GameTopbar has no 'highScore' prop (it was
silently ignored); use the stats API so Score + Best both show.
